text: Can hide test files from PR diff/file tree to focus review on implementation changes
quote: Focus on implementation changes by hiding test files from the PR diff and file tree.

text: Re-reviews new commits after a force-push by safely diffing against the prior reviewed version
quote: cubic now reviews the new changes after a force-push when it can safely compare them with a previously reviewed version.

text: Lets a coding agent check subscription status and manage team seats/roles via MCP
quote: You can now ask your coding agent to check your cubic subscription, manage team seats and roles, and purchase more seats without leaving your MCP client.

text: Automatically reviews new pull requests once installed
quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.

text: Can trigger a review on an existing PR via an @-mention comment command
quote: To review a PR that was opened _before_ you installed the app, comment: `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`.

text: Supports replying to a review comment to ask for clarification
quote: Reply to a review comment to ask for clarification

text: Can auto-generate and push a fix directly to the PR branch from a review comment
quote: Click **Fix with cubic** on a review comment... cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.

text: Provides a CLI command to review uncommitted changes locally before pushing
quote: Run a review before you push to catch issues while you're working.... review your uncommitted changes: `cubic review`

text: Chat can give a step-by-step guided tour of a PR's changes
quote: Ask chat to "tour this PR" for a step-by-step review of the changes and what to check.

text: Can select code and add it to AI chat with diff and codebase as context
quote: Select code and choose **Add to AI chat** to ask about it with the diff and codebase as context.

text: Custom agents can be configured to enforce team coding standards
quote: **Custom agents**: Enforce your team’s coding standards

text: Can auto-approve clean PRs when policy allows, with a shadow mode to preview before going live
quote: cubic can approve clean pull requests automatically when your repository policy allows it. Start in shadow mode to see which PRs cubic would approve, then switch to live mode

text: Offers an 'ultrareview' mode with more capable models for risky or complex changes
quote: Ultrareview runs a longer review using cubic's most capable review models, which is useful for risky migrations, security-sensitive changes, or complex refactors.

text: Can connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription to power local reviews
quote: Connect your existing **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** or **Claude Code** subscription to use its models for local reviews.

text: Provides an MCP server so coding agents can read review findings, request reviews, and triage issues
quote: Connect cubic's MCP server to your coding agent to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage PR or codebase scan issues.

text: Uses a cubic.yaml config file as the source of truth for review behavior, ignore patterns, and custom agents
quote: `cubic.yaml` lives in the root of your repository and becomes the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, and custom agents.

text: Supports an org-wide default config repo (cubic-config) applied to repos without their own settings
quote: Create a repository named `cubic-config` in your organization and add a `cubic.yaml` file to the root directory. cubic automatically applies these settings to any repository that doesn't have its own configuration.

text: Analytics dashboard surfaces AI coding usage, review impact, and delivery speed insights
quote: The analytics dashboard shows how your team ships code across three lenses: AI coding usage, AI review impact, and delivery speed.

text: Can export team member analytics data as CSV
quote: You can export team member data as CSV from both [AI coding](/analytics/ai-coding#csv-export) and [De

text: Provides an Analytics API with PR-level data on flagged/fixed issues and AI-authored code
quote: The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed, how much AI code was authored, etc.

text: Runs codebase-wide scans using many AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities
quote: Codebase scans deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities across your repository.

text: Auto-generates a searchable AI wiki of the codebase with architecture diagrams and source links
quote: cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes your codebase and produces searchable wikis, complete with links to source code, architecture diagrams, and more.

text: Exports the wiki as markdown into the repo and keeps it updated via a rolling PR
quote: cubic exports the wiki as markdown files into a directory in your repo (default `.cubic/wiki`) and keeps them current through a rolling pull request.

text: Can set a monthly spend limit and auto-purchase extra review capacity only as needed
quote: You set a monthly spend limit, and cubic buys extra reviewed-line capacity only when a review would otherwise be paused.
